items.question: Which team won the Premier League in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' AND st.tss_rank=1

items.question: How many points did Arsenal finish with in the 2023-2024 season?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT st.tss_points FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND t.team_name='Arsenal'

items.question: Give the full 2022-2023 Premier League final table (rank, team, points).
items.canonical_sql: SELECT st.tss_rank, t.team_name, st.tss_points FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2022-2023' ORDER BY st.tss_rank

items.question: Which three teams were relegated from the Premier League in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, st.tss_rank FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND st.tss_rank >= 18 ORDER BY st.tss_rank

items.question: Which team had the best goal difference in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' ORDER BY st.tss_goal_difference DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: How many points did Everton actually finish 2023-2024 with, and how many would they have had without the points deduction?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT st.tss_points AS actual_points, (3*st.tss_wins + st.tss_draws) AS points_without_deduction FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND t.team_name='Everton'

items.question: What is the highest points total achieved by any team in a single season across 2020-2021 to 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, s.season, st.tss_points FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id ORDER BY st.tss_points DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which teams finished in the top four in 2021-2022?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT st.tss_rank, t.team_name, st.tss_points FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2021-2022' AND st.tss_rank <= 4 ORDER BY st.tss_rank

items.question: Who was the top goalscorer in the 2023-2024 Premier League season, and how many goals did they score?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY goals DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: List the top five goalscorers in 2024-2025 with their goal totals.
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY goals DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 5

items.question: Who provided the most assists in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.assists_pss) AS assists FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY assists DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: How many league goals did Cole Palmer score in total in 2023-2024 (across all clubs he played for that season)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS total_goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND p.player_name='Cole Palmer' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name

items.question: Which player played the most minutes in 2022-2023?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.minutes_pss) AS minutes FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2022-2023' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY minutes DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Who was Liverpool's top scorer in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=pss.team_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' AND t.team_name='Liverpool' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY goals DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which players scored at least 20 league goals in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 20 ORDER BY goals DESC, p.player_name

items.question: Which team earned the most home points in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, ha.tshas_home_points AS home_points FROM team_season_home_away_standings ha JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=ha.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=ha.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' ORDER BY home_points DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which team recorded the most away wins in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, ha.tshas_away_wins AS away_wins FROM team_season_home_away_standings ha JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=ha.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=ha.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' ORDER BY away_wins DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which team had the biggest gap between home points and away points in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, (ha.tshas_home_points - ha.tshas_away_points) AS home_away_gap FROM team_season_home_away_standings ha JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=ha.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=ha.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' ORDER BY home_away_gap DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: How many home points did Arsenal earn in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT ha.tshas_home_points FROM team_season_home_away_standings ha JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=ha.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=ha.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND t.team_name='Arsenal'

items.question: Which team scored the most home goals in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, ha.tshas_home_goals_for AS home_goals FROM team_season_home_away_standings ha JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=ha.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=ha.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' ORDER BY home_goals DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which team received the most yellow cards in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, sf.tssf_yellow_cards AS yellows FROM team_season_stats_for sf JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=sf.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=sf.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' ORDER BY yellows DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which player received the most yellow cards in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.yellow_cards_pss) AS yellows FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY yellows DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which team picked up the most red cards in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, sf.tssf_red_cards AS reds FROM team_season_stats_for sf JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=sf.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=sf.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' ORDER BY reds DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: How many red cards were shown in total across the league in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT SUM(sf.tssf_red_cards) AS total_red_cards FROM team_season_stats_for sf JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=sf.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024'

items.question: How many Premier League matches did referee Anthony Taylor officiate in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_officiated FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=m.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND replace(m.referee, chr(160), ' ') = 'Anthony Taylor'

items.question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who overperformed their xG by the most (goals minus xG)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.goals_pss) - SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS overperformance FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10 ORDER BY overperformance DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who underperformed their xG by the most (xG minus goals)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss) - SUM(pss.goals_pss),2) AS underperformance FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10 ORDER BY underperformance DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: How many goals did Erling Haaland score in 2023-2024 versus his xG, and what was the difference?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.goals_pss) - SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS difference FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' AND p.player_name='Erling Haaland' GROUP BY p.player_id

items.question: Among players with at least 15 xG in 2024-2025, who had the highest goals-to-xG ratio?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals, ROUND(SUM(pss.xg_pss),2) AS xg, ROUND(SUM(pss.goals_pss)/NULLIF(SUM(pss.xg_pss),0),3) AS goals_per_xg FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pss.player_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pss.xg_pss) >= 15 ORDER BY goals_per_xg DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which team had the most non-penalty expected goals (npxG) from its players combined in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(SUM(pss.npxg_pss),2) AS team_npxg FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=pss.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=pss.season_id WHERE s.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ORDER BY team_npxg DESC, t.team_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which player has the highest market value (most recent valuation on record)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, mv.market_value FROM player_market_values mv JOIN players p ON p.player_id=mv.player_id WHERE (mv.player_id, mv.date_unix) IN (SELECT player_id, MAX(date_unix) FROM player_market_values GROUP BY player_id) ORDER BY mv.market_value DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: What are the five largest transfer fees paid by a Premier League club (incoming transfers) in the data?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, tr.from_team, tr.to_team, tr.season, tr.transfer_fee FROM player_transfers tr JOIN players p ON p.player_id=tr.player_id WHERE tr.to_team IN (SELECT team_name FROM teams) AND tr.transfer_fee IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tr.transfer_fee DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 5

items.question: What was the most expensive incoming transfer to a Premier League club in the 2023-2024 season window?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, tr.to_team, tr.transfer_fee FROM player_transfers tr JOIN players p ON p.player_id=tr.player_id WHERE tr.season='2023-2024' AND tr.to_team IN (SELECT team_name FROM teams) AND tr.transfer_fee IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tr.transfer_fee DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: What is Chelsea's total recorded incoming transfer spend across all seasons in the data?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT SUM(tr.transfer_fee) AS total_spend FROM player_transfers tr WHERE tr.to_team='Chelsea' AND tr.transfer_fee IS NOT NULL

items.question: List the three players with the highest market value at Manchester City (most recent valuation).
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, mv.market_value FROM player_market_values mv JOIN players p ON p.player_id=mv.player_id JOIN player_season_stats pss ON pss.player_id=mv.player_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=pss.team_id WHERE t.team_name='Manchester City' AND (mv.player_id, mv.date_unix) IN (SELECT player_id, MAX(date_unix) FROM player_market_values GROUP BY player_id) GROUP BY p.player_name, mv.market_value ORDER BY mv.market_value DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 3

items.question: Which player missed the most games in a single injury spell in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, pis.games_missed FROM player_injury_spells pis JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pis.player_id WHERE pis.season='2023-2024' ORDER BY pis.games_missed DESC NULLS LAST, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which player missed the most total days to injury across all spells in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pis.days_missed) AS total_days_missed FROM player_injury_spells pis JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pis.player_id WHERE pis.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY total_days_missed DESC NULLS LAST, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: Which club had the most separate injury spells recorded in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT pis.team, COUNT(*) AS spells FROM player_injury_spells pis WHERE pis.season='2023-2024' GROUP BY pis.team ORDER BY spells DESC, pis.team LIMIT 1

items.question: How many injury spells were recorded for Brentford players in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS spells FROM player_injury_spells pis WHERE pis.season='2023-2024' AND pis.team='Brentford'

items.question: Which player attempted the most shots (from event data) in 2023-2024?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS shots FROM match_events e JOIN players p ON p.player_id=e.player_id WHERE e.season='2023-2024' AND e.league_code='ENG-PL' AND e.is_shot = TRUE GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY shots DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the most goals scored by a single player in one match in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, pmp.game_id, pmp.match_goals FROM player_match_performance pmp JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pmp.player_id WHERE pmp.season='2024-2025' AND pmp.league_code='ENG-PL' ORDER BY pmp.match_goals DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 5

items.question: Which player committed the most fouls in 2023-2024 (summed across matches)?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pmp.fouls) AS fouls FROM player_match_performance pmp JOIN players p ON p.player_id=pmp.player_id WHERE pmp.season='2023-2024' AND pmp.league_code='ENG-PL' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name HAVING SUM(pmp.fouls) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fouls DESC, p.player_name LIMIT 1

items.question: How many shot events resulted in a goal (is_goal) in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS goal_events FROM match_events e WHERE e.season='2024-2025' AND e.league_code='ENG-PL' AND e.is_goal = TRUE

items.question: What was the biggest home win (by goal margin) in 2024-2025?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT ht.team_name AS home_team, at.team_name AS away_team, m.home_score, m.away_score FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=m.season_id JOIN teams ht ON ht.team_id=m.home_team_id JOIN teams at ON at.team_id=m.away_team_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' ORDER BY (m.home_score - m.away_score) DESC, m.home_score DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: How many points did Norwich City get in the 2024-2025 Premier League season?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT st.tss_points FROM team_season_standings st JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=st.team_id JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=st.season_id WHERE s.season='2024-2025' AND t.team_name='Norwich City'

items.question: How many matches in the 2020-2021 season have a recorded attendance figure?
items.canonical_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_with_attendance FROM matches m JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id=m.season_id WHERE s.season='2020-2021' AND m.attendance_m IS NOT NULL
